items.title: Shanti Gold buys 2.65 lakh Ratnaveer shares for Rs 8.83 crore in market
items.text: Shanti Gold International bought 2.65 lakh equity shares of Ratnaveer Precision Engineering for Rs 8.83 crore, a weighted average Rs 333.33 per share, giving it about 0.37% of the company. The purchase was a secondary-market transaction. The article calls the stake too small to move the stock or influence governance, but it shows continued investor interest as Ratnaveer builds its CCL plant.
